-- Outbound Infrastructure: Targeted cold calling to stacked lists. The goal here is 10+ leads per day, get your sales team volume and builds the foundation. You can't run a real biz without an outbound engine. 

-- Inbound Infrastructure: Step 1 is social proof (video & written testimonials & google reviews + online content). Then add in PPC and some FB ads. 

Whether you are a flipper, wholesaler, developer, or agent this is the stack I'd be running. The goal is a 4x+ ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) 

3. Operations 

You need to be lean. 

Choose ONE exit strategy unless you are making $1M+ / year in true take home. 

Don't be the flipper that wholesales that develops that syndicates yet only makes 250k per year. 

Build your team around incentives & revenue.

Developer: Don't become a builder, hire legit PMs and builders and do the same. 

Wholesaler: Overpay great sales people (25% or more per deal) 

Once you nail strategy, almost all operational dollars should go to things that have a clear ROI. 

Your software stack shouldn't be more than $2,500 per month.

The code that decides who sees this post is on GitHub. So is Grok's coding agent, and an official plugin that lets Claude Code hand work to Grok.

All from @spacexai, formerly xAI. Most people never open its GitHub.

Builders did the rest. In 12 weeks: a terminal CLI for Grok Bot, a Telegram bridge, a memory editor, a https://t.co/aWl55CwlqL pipeline where one Grok agent's only job is to find reasons not to buy, and a catalog of 7,328 shared bots.

20 repos worth opening:

From SpaceXSI

01 Grok Build → Grok's open-source coding agent, written in Rust. Runs in your terminal, headless in CI or inside your editor, with skills, plugins, hooks and MCP. 27.7k stars
https://t.co/83LUb4Xj8h

02 Grok Build for Claude Code → an official plugin. Claude Code asks Grok for a code review or a design critique, delegates a fix, or moves the whole session into Grok with one command. Reviews run in a read-only sandbox
https://t.co/qcxojK1AsK

03 X For You algorithm → the ranking code itself. A post's score is a weighted sum of 25 predicted actions, from likes and DM shares to dwell time and "not dwelled". In October, ranking got better at predicting time spent, and retrieval started surfacing posts people read to the end. Posts older than 48 hours are filtered out
https://t.co/bEW4SlUcvi

04 Community Writer → the AI that drafts Community Notes. It picks posts from note requests, screenshots every cited source to check it, and withdraws notes that get rated poorly. People still decide which notes show
https://t.co/w5HoauMuiJ

05 Plugin Marketplace → the official plugin catalog for Grok Build, forked 1,175 times. The README says third-party plugins aren't verified, so read before you install
https://t.co/3pKXfyDixI

From builders

06 grok-bot-cli by @ScriptedAlchemy → run Grok Bot from your terminal. `gbot` creates bots and group chats, messages them, reads threads and cleans up. It uses the desktop app's login, no token copying
https://t.co/7gGgB5BUhP

07 grokbot-headless by @rac → runs the official Grok Bot local-computer daemon on a Linux server with no screen. Yes, the Grammy-winning RAC. It uses an internal protocol, so an app update can break it
https://t.co/4S5q7POT77

08 grokbot-usage-cli by @brandon_ai → your bots check their own usage before they burn it: the weekly Grok Bot pool, your Cursor plan and SuperGrok. Read-only
https://t.co/335z1Nk1ZF

09 grokbot-local-agent → Grok Bot hands heavy jobs to a Pi agent on its own computer, billed to your separate model account, and a webhook wakes the bot to check the result. Your weekly allowance lasts longer
https://t.co/gBAHyu2Uxm

10 Telegram bridge by @ssbrouhard → talk to Grok Bot from Telegram. It runs inside the bot's computer with no inbound ports, an allowlist and zero dependencies
https://t.co/O1YSPGA2X0

11 iMessage skill by @jhuber → Grok Bot reads, triages, searches and sends your iMessages on a Mac. It needs Full Disk Access, and the author says to read SECURITY.md first
https://t.co/d6vARQTSmA

12 agent-cookie-sync by @reinventingai → your cloud bot gets the sites you're already signed into in Chrome, no passwords pasted. Powerful and risky: a session cookie is your account
https://t.co/1mZPYG11J7

13 Grok Bot Inbox by @ethantroy → your own email inbox on Cloudflare Workers that Grok Bot reaches over MCP, with a prompt-injection scan and a separate model that verifies actions
https://t.co/dYvbkojb3O

14 souhun → a Mac and Windows app to see, add and delete what each of your Grok Bots remembers. Released Nov 2
https://t.co/Qwcd07NZyO

15 Grok Bot Clipper by @cgnot996 → a browser extension that sends pages, long screenshots and X posts to your bots. Crop and redact before you send
https://t.co/Kxr4wT8Fdv
